# Journal of Coastal Frontiers & Applied Development (JCFAD)

> Journal of Coastal Frontiers & Applied Development (JCFAD) is an international open-access, peer-reviewed scientific periodical (e-ISSN: In Process / BRIN National ISSN Registry) published by PT Chain Asia Conect. It focuses on coastal engineering, 3T frontier logistics, IoT-blockchain cold-storage, maritime transportation, and applied socio-legal frameworks in conservation buffer zones (TNBBS & Pesisir Barat, Indonesia).

- **Canonical URL:** https://journal.chainasiaconnect.co.id
- **Publisher:** PT Chain Asia Conect
- **Publication Frequency:** Biannual (March & September)
- **License:** Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
- **Access Model:** Diamond Open Access (No Article Processing Charges / APC)
- **Primary PIDs:** DataCite DOI (Zenodo CERN) & Crossref / OSF Global Registry

---

- **Topics:** Landslide geohazard modeling, Indonesian Civil Code (KUHPerdata Arts. 1244-1245), smart legal contracts, Liwa-Krui logistics artery.
